item: A-037: four unused analytics helpers removed, one moved to its test
summary: Removed skeleton_signature, excluded_set, subjectivity available_languages and stoplist_recompute.needs_run (no production caller; needs_run superseded by maybe_recompute_top_keywords, which decides each off-peak window); _is_contiguous_sub moved into its only user, the frozen pairwise reference; columnar comment no longer promises a caller for secure_crypto_reason. is_managed kept as ruled. Found by a name scan, so a computed-string use would not be seen.
